extDescription.message: Redirect the new tab to your custom homepage

headerSubtitle.message: Choose what opens in a new tab.

hpHelp.message: Supports domains, intranet addresses and IPv6. HTTPS is assumed when the scheme is omitted; use http:// for local services.

errMsg.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL, e.g. kagi.com or http://localhost:3000/.

chipsAria.message: Quickly fill in a homepage URL

statusLoadFail.message: Couldn't load settings. Your existing settings are unchanged.

statusDirty.message: Unsaved changes. Save the schedule to apply them.

statusSaved.message: Schedule saved. Changes apply on your next new tab.

statusOtherPageUpdate.message: Your draft is still here. Review the saved schedule before continuing.

statusRefreshFail.message: Couldn't read the updated settings. Reopen the settings page later.

warnInvalidSaved.message: Saved homepage URL is invalid — using the default homepage for now. Please save your settings again.

recoverySlow.message: Redirect hasn't finished yet — open the homepage manually or check settings.

recoveryLoadFail.message: Couldn’t read saved settings. Trying to open the homepage.

recoveryRedirectFail.message: Automatic redirect failed — open the homepage manually or check settings.

scheduleHelp.message: Rules use this device’s local time. Overnight rules start on the selected days.

ruleDaysError.message: Select at least one start day.

ruleEqualTimes.message: Start and end times must differ.

ruleGenericError.message: Remove this rule and add it again.

previewInvalidDraft.message: Fix the URL or weekly rules to preview this draft.

repeatedLocalTime.message: This local time occurs twice. The first occurrence is used.

invalidDate.message: Choose a valid local date and time. If the clock skips this time, choose another time.

invalidTemporaryDate.message: Choose a valid local date and time in the future.

temporaryChanged.message: Another settings tab changed the temporary homepage. Review the current homepage before trying again.

scheduleConflict.message: Another settings tab saved changes. Review its schedule before applying your draft.

warnInvalidSchedule.message: Invalid or overlapping weekly rules were skipped. Verify the remaining rules and save the schedule to repair it.

warnInvalidTemporary.message: The saved temporary homepage is invalid. Enable a temporary homepage to replace it.
